publicly_readable: One article, reprinted on worldin.economist.com in 2015 for the 30th edition ("Another year, another billion", by John Parker), read from an Internet Archive snapshot.
not_readable: Everything else in the issue. No other text of this edition was found in public form.

entries.quote: At the turn of 2011-12, another Adnan will be chosen. At about that point, the seven-billionth living person will be born
entries.subject: World population reaches 7 billion
entries.note: The article gives a window "ranging from mid-2011 to mid-2012".

notes: Edition number counted from The World in 1987 = 1. Publication month not confirmed; year only. The reprint is The Economist's own web copy of the original article.
